summary.text: John Hollinrake is the Republican candidate for Iowa State Senate District 21 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Heather Matson.
According to his campaign website, he founded Hollinrake Properties, a real estate development company, and is Deputy State Director for U.S. Senator Joni Ernst.

paragraphs.text: John Hollinrake says on his campaign website that he was born in Des Moines and raised in Ankeny, the son of two military parents.
The site says he graduated from Ankeny Centennial High School and George Mason University and is pursuing an MBA at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
It lists him as founder of Hollinrake Properties, based in the Des Moines area, and as Deputy State Director for Senator Ernst.
Hollinrake advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, according to Ballotpedia.
His campaign website quotes him saying it is time to bring property tax relief to Iowans, invest in schools and make it easier for working families to thrive.
